question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Chip off the old block

options.text: Someone who makes the right decision
Someone who tries to escape from their parents

solution:
The correct answer is Someone who resembles their parent.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the idiom 'Chip off the old block' is 'Someone who resembles their parent.'
 
• Chip off the old block: someone who is very similar in character to their father or mother.
 
 
• *Example: Mark just won the same sailboat race his father won twenty years ago; he's a **chip off the old block**.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above the correct answer is option 1.

Correct meaning:__ *Someone who resembles their parent*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**
